# Data trigger map

Each data class that SSLS does not currently hold, and what would attach if it did. Current use is
false for every class in this table; that is the finding, not an omission.

| Data class                                              | Current use | Future candidate | Sensitivity | Domains activated                                    | Prerequisite review                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ---------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Student identity and demographic data                   | no          | yes              | high        | student-privacy, records-retention, interoperability | Legal review plus an executed district data privacy agreement                            |
| Special-education and multilingual-learner program data | no          | yes              | high        | student-privacy, records-retention, interoperability | Legal review; IDEA confidentiality analysis; Ed-Fi domain mapping                        |
| Staff and operator identity                             | no          | yes              | elevated    | security, procurement                                | Security review before any authentication is added                                       |
| Payroll, payment or government identifier data          | no          | yes              | high        | security, records-retention                          | 201 CMR 17.00 written information security program must exist first                      |
| Product telemetry and usage analytics                   | no          | yes              | elevated    | student-privacy, public-surface                      | Privacy review; surveillance-metric refusal rules already prohibit individual monitoring |
| Support correspondence and free text                    | no          | yes              | elevated    | student-privacy, records-retention                   | Privacy review                                                                           |

## Minimum-necessary position and unresolved questions

### Student identity and demographic data

- Minimum necessary: Identifier, enrolment relationship and program status only. No free-text narrative in the first model.
- Retention question: Which record type is the transcript equivalent and which is the temporary record?
- Disclosure question: Who may see a student outside the assigned service relationship, and under what recorded purpose?

### Special-education and multilingual-learner program data

- Minimum necessary: Program participation and service delivery facts. Not clinical narrative.
- Retention question: What triggers destruction when services end?
- Disclosure question: How is disability status prevented from leaking through interface projections and search?

### Staff and operator identity

- Minimum necessary: Account identifier and acting capacity. No personal contact detail beyond what authentication requires.
- Retention question: How long does an inactive account persist?
- Disclosure question: Is any operator identity rendered on a public surface?

### Payroll, payment or government identifier data

- Minimum necessary: Handled by a processor wherever possible rather than held.
- Retention question: What is the disposal standard, including third-party disposal?
- Disclosure question: Who inside the organisation can reach it?

### Product telemetry and usage analytics

- Minimum necessary: Aggregate system health only. No per-student or per-staff behavioural profile.
- Retention question: What is the shortest useful retention window?
- Disclosure question: Could an aggregate be re-identified in a small district or low-incidence program?

### Support correspondence and free text

- Minimum necessary: Free text is the least controllable data class and should be bounded or avoided.
- Retention question: Does correspondence containing student detail become part of the education record?
- Disclosure question: How is inadvertent student PII in free text detected and removed?
